name: Blueberry Crunch Overnight Oats
steps: Roughly chop the nuts and place them into a dry frying pan. Place onto medium heat and toast, stirring often, until golden, 5-8 mins. Tip half into a bowl and stir the honey and the rest of the topping ingredients through. Store in an airtight container at room temperature.
In the empty pan, make the base: Tip in the frozen blueberries and honey on medium heat and stir until the blueberries have defrosted. Remove from the heat and let it cool down.

Add the oats and remaining frozen blueberries into the bowl with the nuts. Coarsely grate the apple into the mixture and stir through the lemon zest, milk, and yoghurt. Season with as much honey as you’d like, and a pinch of salt
Share the blueberry coulis into jars and ladle the oat mixture on top. Cover and refrigerate overnight so the oats can soften. Once ready to eat, serve the blueberry pots with the toasted nuts.

pt.name: Aveia Noturna Crocante de Mirtilo
steps: Pique grosseiramente os frutos secos e coloque-os numa frigideira seca. Leve a lume médio e torre, mexendo frequentemente, até dourarem, 5 a 8 minutos. Coloque metade numa tigela e misture o mel e os restantes ingredientes da cobertura. Guarde num recipiente hermético à temperatura ambiente.
Na frigideira vazia, prepare a base: adicione os mirtilos congelados e o mel em lume médio e mexa até os mirtilos descongelarem. Retire do lume e deixe arrefecer.

Adicione a aveia e os mirtilos congelados restantes à tigela com os frutos secos. Rale a maçã grosseiramente para a mistura e misture a raspa de limão, o leite e o iogurte. Tempere com mel a gosto e uma pitada de sal.
Distribua o coulis de mirtilo pelos frascos e coloque a mistura de aveia por cima. Cubra e refrigere durante a noite para a aveia amolecer. Quando estiver pronto, sirva com os frutos secos tostados.
